name: supervised-signal-feasibility-2026-10-20
hypothesis: A fixed supervised learner may extract a training-era 20-session signal that PPO has not learned; test predictive feasibility before any policy warm start.
mask: Both arms have10 inputs; masked zeros the last3 context fields. Identical initial model tensors per seed.

target.entry: Next session open, after entry-day corporate actions
target.exit: 20th session close, including later splits and cash dividends
target.kind: Gross log unit total return; no reinvestment of dividends
target.label_availability: Exit bar available_time; never before completion
target.exclusions: No execution costs, borrow, stops, targets, or whole-share rounding; a forecast label, not an oracle trading action

folds.project_validation: Never used for supervision, preprocessing or feasibility scoring
folds.purge: Discard every window straddling fit/probe, episode end, or training end; source episodes already split at known gaps
folds.normalization: Refit raw feature means/scales on fit rows only; ignore source pooled2010-2020 normalizer

feasibility_gate.per_seed_pass: Final overall probe MSE must improve at least2% versus BOTH constant and the same-arm ridge.
feasibility_gate.yearly_and_ic_aggregation: Average final MLP metrics equally across seeds; require every probe year to pass its baseline limits.
feasibility_gate.feature_information_comparison: Report paired full-minus-masked MSE by seed; descriptive, not an additional gate.
feasibility_gate.ranking: Among passing candidates use lowest mean final probe MSE; exact ties follow declared candidate order. No checkpoint selection.
feasibility_gate.interpretation: Two declared feature candidates, overlapping targets and correlated symbols are not independent samples; no p-value or trading-profit claim. If neither passes stop; no automatic PPO allocation.

execution.training_location: Google Colab CPU only; actual default Python checked first
execution.runner: Existing centrally metered owned fleet; shared original ledger; retrieve and verify artifacts before shutdown
execution.preflight: Within the CPU allocation, run finite-loss and save/load/schema checks on a tiny prefix before the fixed full fits; stop on failure.

constraints.declining_stock_labels: Validation/prospective decline cohorts reporting only; never inputs, supervision, sampling, rewards or checkpoint selection
constraints.training_future_targets: Only completed training-era outcomes used as supervision, never inputs
constraints.ppo_warm_start: Not implemented; any subsequent allocation requires a separate preregistered matched policy protocol and unchanged learned protection/execution contract.
constraints.profitability: Predictive feasibility cannot satisfy the stock/ETF return goal; matched trading evaluation and prospective evidence remain necessary
